subject: Mathematics
title: Expanded form and zero as a place holder

warmup.q: How many hundreds, tens and ones are in 352?
Write the number: 8 hundreds, 1 ten, 6 ones.
What is the value of the 4 in 640?

teach.heading: Expanded form
teach.body: Expanded form shows a number as the sum of its parts. 346 = 300 + 40 + 6. Each part is the value of one digit.

teach.heading: Zero holds a place
teach.body: In 407 there are 4 hundreds, 0 tens and 7 ones. The zero holds the tens place so the 4 stays in the hundreds place. Without it, 47 and 407 would look the same.

teach.heading: Expanded form with zeros
teach.body: We can leave out parts that are zero. 407 = 400 + 0 + 7, or just 400 + 7. 350 = 300 + 50.

teach.heading: Going backwards
teach.body: To turn expanded form back into a number, write each part in its place. 600 + 20 + 5 is 625. 800 + 3 is 803, because there are no tens.

worked_examples.steps: 7 is in the hundreds place: 700. 2 is in the tens place: 20. 5 is in the ones place: 5.

guided_practice.hint: Split into hundreds, tens and ones.
Put each part in its place.
What is in the tens place?

questions: C. Fix the mistake: Sam wrote 'six hundred and five' as 65. What number should he write? Explain what the zero does.
D. A mystery number is between 400 and 500. Its tens digit is double its ones digit and its ones digit is 3. What is it?
answers: C. 605. The zero holds the tens place so the 6 stays in the hundreds place.

quiz.explain: No tens, so a zero holds the tens place.
2 is in the hundreds place, 7 is in the tens place.

quiz.q: The zero in 509 shows there are
quiz.explain: The zero is in the tens place.
